cases.declared_play: Set D.D. Warrior Lady from my hand face-down in Monster Zone 3. Stop with an opponent response decision (actor human, window after_set); do not activate or resolve an effect.

71413901.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
71413901.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

7572887.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
7572887.desc: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

77538567.name: Dark Bribe
77538567.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the Spell/Trap activation, and if you do, destroy it.

44095762.name: Mirror Force
44095762.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

4929256.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
4929256.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

68005187.name: Soul Exchange
68005187.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

87910978.name: Brain Control
87910978.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

40737112.name: Dark Magician of Chaos
40737112.desc: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos" once per turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.

81866673.name: Destiny HERO - Dasher
81866673.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other monster; this card gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase. If this card attacks, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. One time only, when you draw a Monster Card during your Draw Phase while this card is in your Graveyard: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. This card must be in the Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

5318639.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
5318639.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.
